english.title: Cause quitting of a motor vehicle

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to leave on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not attended by a person licensed to drive it, when the

(A)_[engine had not been stopped]_
(B)_[parking brake had not been effectively set]_
(C)_[engine had not been stopped and the parking brake effectively set]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 107(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause the quitting of a motor vehicle on a road
leave it unattended by licensed person
failed to stop engine/parking brake not set

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence is NOT committed if there is a person, licensed to drive somewhere in the vehicle.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H217 and H262.
(iv) Information may be added to the Statement of Facts giving details of any movement of the vehicle and damage caused thereby.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when it was not attended by a person licensed to drive the vehicle and with the

(A)_[engine running.]_
(B)_[hand brake not effectively set.]_
(C)_[engine running and the hand brake not effectively set.]_

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
